text: To recenter, press wasd or hold+drag the middle mouse button.
translation: 要重新居中，請按 WASD，或按住滑鼠中鍵拖動。

text: You have arrived. After a journey from the Mountainhomes into the forbidding wilderness beyond, your harsh trek has finally ended. Your party of seven is to make an outpost for the glory of all of {{civilization}}.
translation: 你們抵達了。歷經從山中家園前往外界險惡荒野的旅程，艱苦跋涉終於結束。你們七人的隊伍將在此建立前哨站，為 {{civilization}} 的榮耀而奮鬥。

text: There are almost no supplies left, but with stout labor comes sustenance. Whether by bolt, plow or hook, provide for your dwarves. You are expecting a supply caravan just before winter entombs you, but it is {{season}} now. Enough time to delve secure lodgings, ere the {{creature}} get hungry.
translation: 補給幾乎耗盡，但堅實的勞作會帶來生計。無論使用弩箭、犁鏵還是魚鉤，都要養活你們的矮人。你們預計在嚴冬封困此地之前會有一支補給商隊到來，不過現在是 {{season|day::season}}。還有足夠時間開鑿安全住所，趕在飢餓的 {{creature|creatures}} 撲來之前。

text: A new chapter of dwarven history begins here at this place, {{site}}, "{{epithet}}".
translation: 矮人歷史的新篇章將在此地 {{site}}——“{{epithet}}”——拉開序幕。

text: She dislikes receiving advice, preferring to keep her own counsel. She is often nervous. She prefers to present herself modestly. She is grateful when others help her out and tries to return favors. She likes to keep things practical, without delving too deeply into the abstract. She is quite ambitious. She tends to avoid crowds. She tends to be passive in discussions. She is slow to anger. She often feels discouraged. She tends to consider what others think of her. She is rarely happy or enthusiastic, and she is conflicted by this as she values parties and merrymaking in the abstract.
translation: 她不喜歡接受建議，更願意保留自己的看法。她經常感到緊張。她傾向於表現得謙遜。別人幫助她時，她會心懷感激，並設法回報。她喜歡務實，不願過多鑽研抽象事物。她相當有抱負。她往往避開人群，在討論中比較被動。她不易動怒，卻經常感到氣餒。她很在意別人對自己的看法。她很少感到快樂或熱情，而這與她在理念上重視聚會和歡慶相沖突。

text: Set tree chopping orders.  Select the base of the tree so that the woodcutter can reach it.  Assign a woodcutter to the work detail if necessary.  The woodcutter requires an axe.
translation: 設定伐木命令。選擇樹木根部，使伐木工能夠到達。必要時，將一名伐木工分配到對應的工作分工。伐木工需要一把斧頭。

text: Set wall smoothing, engraving, track carving, and fortification orders.
translation: 設定牆面平整、雕刻、軌道刻槽和防禦工事命令。

text: Remove mining, woodcutting, plant gathering, and smoothing orders.
translation: 取消採礦、伐木、植物採集和平整命令。

text: Place structures and work areas that require construction materials.
translation: 放置需要建築材料的建築和作業區。
設定用於儲存物品的儲藏區。

text: Place zones to establish meeting areas, pastures, and more.
translation: 劃定區域以建立集會區、牧場等。

text: Establish burrows to organize work and living spaces in larger fortresses.
translation: 建立活動區，以便在大型要塞中組織工作和生活空間。

text: Set high and low traffic areas.
translation: 設定高、低通行優先順序區域。

text: Designate items for dumping and melting, claim forbidden items and buildings, and set item visibility.
translation: 指定要傾倒和熔化的物品，認領被停用的物品和建築，並設定物品可見性。

text: Click an icon to add a new zone.
Select a type below to add a zone.
translation: 從下方選擇一種型別以新增區域。

text: Dig a regular hallway or room.  Assign a miner to the work detail if necessary.  The miner requires a pick.
translation: 開挖普通走廊或房間。必要時，將一名礦工分配到對應的工作分工。礦工需要一把鶴嘴鋤。

text: Dig a stairwell on this level, going up or down.  Your selection must span multiple elevations.  Click on a tile, change elevations, and click again.
translation: 在本層開挖向上或向下的樓梯井。你的選擇必須跨越多個高度層。單擊一個地塊，切換高度層，然後再次單擊。

text: Dig a ramp on this level, going up.
translation: 在本層開挖一個向上的斜坡。

text: Dig a channel, making a ramp on the level below.
translation: 開挖溝渠，在下一層形成斜坡。

text: Designate constructed walls, floors, and other constructed tiles to be removed by miners.  This also designates all stairwells and ramps.
translation: 指定由礦工拆除已建造的牆、地板和其他已建造地塊。這也會指定拆除所有樓梯井和斜坡。

text: Left click to choose corners of a rectangle.
translation: 單擊滑鼠左鍵選擇矩形的兩個角。
完成設定植物採集命令。

text: Start painting a new stockpile.  Once the tiles are chosen, you'll be able to set the details.
translation: 開始繪製新的儲藏區。選擇地塊後，你可以設定詳細選項。
正在指定高通行優先順序區域
完成設定通行優先順序區域。

text: Set a low traffic area. Citizens will look for better routes.
translation: 設定低通行優先順序區域。居民會尋找更好的路線。

text: Set a normal traffic area, the default state.
translation: 設定普通通行優先順序區域，這是預設狀態。

text: Set a restricted traffic area.  Citizens will look hard for better routes.  They will still use the area if other routes do not exist or are too long.
translation: 設定限制通行區域。居民會盡力尋找更好的路線。如果不存在其他路線或其他路線過長，他們仍會通過該區域。

text: Set a high traffic area.  Use this in wide central passages.
translation: 設定高通行優先順序區域。適用於寬闊的中央通道。
正在認領被停用的物品和建築
完成設定物品/建築標記。

text: Forbid your citizens from using an item or building.
translation: 禁止居民使用某件物品或建築。

text: Claim a forbidden item or building so it will be used by your citizens.
translation: 認領被停用的物品或建築，使居民可以使用它。

text: Dig only ore and gems selected, and automine any ore and gems of the same type which are uncovered.
translation: 僅挖掘選中的礦石和寶石，並自動挖掘之後發現的同類礦石和寶石。

text: Dig only ore and gems selected.
translation: 僅挖掘選中的礦石和寶石。

translation: 選中地塊的優先順序為非常高。

text: Selected tiles are very low priority.
translation: 選中地塊的優先順序為非常低。
正在平整粗糙的地板和牆壁

text: Smooth a rough wall to make it more pleasing to your citizens.  This also prepares the wall for engraving or fortification.
translation: 平整粗糙牆面，使居民感覺更加舒適。這也會為牆面雕刻或開鑿射擊孔做好準備。

text: Engrave artwork into a smooth wall.
translation: 在平整牆面上雕刻藝術作品。

text: Carve a gap in a smooth wall to allow your archers to fire upon invaders.
translation: 在平整牆面上開鑿射擊孔，讓弓弩手能夠射擊入侵者。

text: Carve a track in a stone floor.  Tracks are used by minecarts with routes set in the hauling menu.
translation: 在石質地板上開鑿軌道。軌道供已在運輸選單中設定路線的礦車使用。

text: More complicated buildings from wells to powered machine components to levers and floodgates are found here.
translation: 水井、動力機械部件、控制桿和閘門等較複雜的建築可在此找到。

text: Cages, ropes, and animal traps are found here.  Cages can be used in cage traps or to transport large animals.  Metal cages and chains are also used by the justice system.
translation: 籠子、繩索和動物陷阱可在此找到。籠子可用於籠式陷阱或運輸大型動物。金屬籠和鎖鏈也用於司法系統。

text: Most terrain-altering constructions can be found here, from walls and floors to bridges, ramps, stairs, and more.
translation: 大多數改變地形的建築都可在此找到，包括牆壁、地板、橋梁、斜坡、樓梯等。

text: Place doors and hatches here after you have constructed them in an appropriate workshop.
translation: 在相應工坊中製造門和艙門後，可在此進行放置。

text: Use options in this category to place furniture that has already been constructed in a workshop.
translation: 使用此分類中的選項來放置已經在工坊中製造好的傢俱。

text: Most tasks in the fortress are started and completed at workshops.  Tasks generally require raw materials and most workshops are constructed from boulders, blocks, or wood.
translation: 要塞中的大多數任務都在工坊中開始並完成。任務通常需要原材料，而大多數工坊由巨石、石塊或木材建造。

text: Archery targets, siege weapons, and some ornamental display items can be found in this category.
translation: 射箭靶、攻城武器和一些裝飾性展示品可在此分類中找到。

text: This crucial building is where all trading will be done.  Pack animals from distant civilizations will need to access this building from the edge of the map.  Later, wagons will need a clear 3-wide path to the depot.
translation: 這座關鍵建築是所有貿易進行的場所。來自遙遠文明的馱畜需要能從地圖邊緣抵達這座建築。之後，貨車還需要一條通往貿易站、寬度為3格的暢通道路。

text: Various mechanical traps can be found here.  The pressure plate is also found here, which has applications beyond traps.
translation: 各種機械陷阱可在此找到。壓力板也在這裡，其用途並不侷限於陷阱。

text: Open the nobles and administrators menu.
translation: 開啟貴族和管理人員選單。

text: Prepare to guide your stout charges to fortune in a world fraught with many perils. You'll begin by creating your world and watching the region's history unfold. Once this process is complete, you can prepare a group and send them out to seek wealth deep in the mountains. As you dig deeper and more citizens take up residence in your outpost, your doings will attract attention, both wanted and unwanted. Deal with challenges as they arise, and you might one day find that your humble settlement has grown to become a Mountainhome, the center of your civilization.
translation: 準備帶領堅毅的子民，在危機四伏的世界中追尋財富。你將從創造世界開始，並觀看這片區域的歷史徐徐展開。這個過程完成後，你可以籌備一支隊伍，派他們深入群山尋找財富。隨著你不斷向深處開掘，越來越多的居民定居在前哨站，你的所作所為將引來關注——有你想要的，也有你不想要的。應對接踵而至的挑戰，也許有一天，你會發現這座不起眼的聚落已經成長為山中之家，成為整個文明的中心。

text: If this is your first time playing, please heed the embark warnings about aquifers, saltwater, and other hazards. Some locations are challenging even for experienced players, and it will be a very short game indeed if you don't know how to deal with them![B]After you embark, help is available by pressing the help button in the top right corner, including all of the tutorials.
translation: 如果這是你第一次遊玩，請務必留意出發警告中關於含水層、鹽水及其他危險的提示。有些地點即使對經驗豐富的玩家也頗具挑戰；如果不知道如何應對，遊戲很快就會結束。[B]啟程之後，點選右上角的幫助按鈕即可檢視幫助，其中包括所有教程。

text: Would you like your fortress located in a forested mineral-rich region of this world where you can play through a short tutorial? Non-interactive help will be available whatever you decide.
translation: 你想把要塞設在這個世界中森林茂密、礦產豐富的地區，並體驗一個簡短教程嗎？無論如何選擇，都可以使用非互動式幫助。

text: Start immediately with the default skills, equipment, and animals.
translation: 使用預設技能、裝備和動物立即開始。

text: Click "Embark" to place your fortress.  Right click to zoom out.
translation: 點選“啟程”放置你的要塞。右鍵單擊可縮小地圖。

text: Click the map to zoom in and choose your embark location.
translation: 點選地圖放大，並選擇你的出發地點。

text: Designate an item for dumping in a dumping zone.
translation: 將物品標記為傾倒到垃圾傾倒區。

text: Designate an item for melting at any smelter.
translation: 將物品標記為在任意熔爐中熔化。

text: Hide an item or building from your view.  Citizens will still use it.
translation: 隱藏某件物品或建築，使其不再顯示。居民仍會使用它。

text: Customize this creature's nickname and profession nickname.
translation: 自定義該生物的暱稱和職業暱稱。

text: Set the camera to follow this creature.
Send this creature to a linked site, or expel this creature entirely.
translation: 派遣該生物前往關聯地點，或將其徹底驅逐。

text: Embark with a group to start a settlement.
translation: 帶領一支隊伍出發，建立聚落。

text: Your citizens will build, mine, craft, trade, fight, and manage as you guide your outpost through its history.  Design the shape and purpose of the fortress by issuing orders for the residents to follow.
translation: 你的居民會建造、採礦、製作、貿易、戰鬥和管理，而你將帶領前哨站走過漫長曆史。向居民下達命令，規劃要塞的形態與用途。

text: You can play a sequence of fortresses and adventurers in the same world.  Migrants from retired and abandoned fortresses may come to visit, along with any surviving adventurers.
translation: 你可以在同一個世界中依次遊玩多個要塞和冒險者。來自已退役或廢棄要塞的移民可能前來造訪，倖存的冒險者也可能隨行。

text: Items designated for dumping will be tossed into open air spaces included in this zone.  If no open air tiles are included, they will dump the items on the floor.
translation: 標記為傾倒的物品會被扔進此區域內的露天空格。如果區域內沒有露天空格，矮人就會把物品倒在地面上。

text: Animals that are capable of being trained receive their training at this zone once they have been assigned a trainer from the Pets/Livestock menu.  Generally, a piece of meat is required.
translation: 可訓練的動物在“寵物/牲畜”選單中指定訓練員後，會在此區域接受訓練。通常需要一塊肉。

text: Deceased citizens and pets can be laid to rest in a tomb.  It should include a coffin, casket, or sarcophagus.
translation: 已故居民和寵物可以安葬在陵墓中。陵墓內應放置棺材、靈柩或石棺。

text: Your archers can train in this zone if there is an archery target included.
translation: 如果區域內包含射箭靶，你的弓箭手就能在這裡訓練。

text: Squads should be assigned to a barracks. The squad can be set to train, sleep, and store equipment there.
translation: 應當為小隊分配兵營。你可以設定小隊在兵營中訓練、睡眠和存放裝備。

text: Dormitories should include multiple beds and will not belong to a particular citizen.
translation: 宿舍應包含多張床，且不專屬於任何一位居民。

text: An office or study is required for certain official tasks, such as approving work orders and bookkeeping.  A chair or throne is required for these functions.
translation: 批准工作訂單、記賬等公務需要辦公室或書房。要執行這些職能，區域內必須有椅子或王座。

text: This important zone is where your citizens will gather to socialize.  Crucially, the meeting area is where locations such as taverns, temples, hospitals, and the like are established.
translation: 居民會聚集在這個重要區域進行社交。更關鍵的是，酒館、神殿、醫院等場所都要建立在會面區內。

text: Your citizens will sleep in bedrooms.  It should include a bed!  Try to enclose it with walls and/or doors.  Do not overlap with other rooms.
translation: 居民會在臥室中睡覺。臥室必須有一張床！儘量用牆壁和/或門將其圍住，並且不要與其他房間重疊。

text: Your citizens will eat at this zone.  When not assigned to a particular citizen, citizens without their own dining hall will eat here.  Tables and adjacent chairs should be included.
translation: 居民會在此區域用餐。如果未將其分配給特定居民，沒有私人餐廳的居民會在這裡吃飯。區域內應包含桌子及相鄰的椅子。

text: Certain livestock need to graze on grass.  Assign these animals to a pasture zone.  No fencing is needed.
translation: 某些牲畜需要在草地上放牧。請將這些動物分配到牧場區域；無需修建圍欄。

text: Prisoners convicted in the Justice menu can be incarcerated at a chain or metal cage in the dungeon zone.
translation: 在“司法”選單中被定罪的囚犯，可以關押在地牢區域內的鎖鏈或金屬籠中。

text: Your citizens will drink at a water source zone or gather water using buckets for various tasks.  This is useful if you don't have a functioning well and you want to control exactly where the tasks take place.
translation: 居民會在水源區域飲水，或用桶取水完成各種工作。如果沒有可用的水井，且希望精確控制取水工作的地點，這種區域會很有用。

text: Citizens assigned to the fishing work detail will fish in this zone if it exists.  Otherwise, they will fish everywhere.
translation: 如果存在捕魚區域，被分配到捕魚工作細節的居民會在這裡捕魚；否則他們會到處捕魚。

text: Animals assigned to pit/pond zones are dumped in the pit, but will leave the zone afterward if possible.  If the pit is designated as a pond, your citizens will attempt to fill it with water using buckets.
translation: 分配到坑塘區域的動物會被扔進坑中，但如果可能，之後仍會離開該區域。如果將坑設為池塘，居民會嘗試用桶裝水將其填滿。

text: Your citizens will fill sand bags at this zone if a sandy floor or sandy wall is included. This task is initiated manually at the glass furnace.
translation: 如果區域內包含沙質地面或沙牆，居民會在這裡裝填沙袋。此任務需要在玻璃熔爐中手動發起。

text: Your citizens will collect clay at this zone if a clay floor or clay wall is included.  This task is initiated manually at the kiln.
translation: 如果區域內包含黏土地面或黏土牆，居民會在這裡採集黏土。此任務需要在窯爐中手動發起。

text: Plant gathering zones are used in locations where plants will be gathered frequently.  Use the gather designation otherwise.
translation: 採集區域適合設定在需要頻繁採集植物的地點；其他情況下請使用採集指定。

text: You do not have any zones.
Zones can be added using the zone menu at the bottom of the screen.
translation: 可以使用螢幕底部的區域選單新增區域。

text: Open the stocks window, where you can see all of your fortress's items.
translation: 開啟庫存視窗，在這裡可以檢視要塞中的所有物品。
警告：該儲藏區尚未設定型別。

text: Click an icon to set stockpile type.
translation: 點選圖示以設定儲藏區型別。

text: Set from which workshops and stockpiles this stockpile gives and takes items.
translation: 設定該儲藏區向哪些工坊和儲藏區提供物品，以及從哪些工坊和儲藏區接收物品。

text: Set how many barrerls, bins, and wheelbarrows this stockpile can use.
translation: 設定該儲藏區可以使用的圓桶、箱櫃和獨輪車數量。

text: This may take a long while!
The wildlife might be very dangerous here.
translation: 這裡的野生動物可能非常危險。

text: You have selected a savage area.
translation: 你選擇了一個蠻荒區域。

text: You need a broker with the appraisal skill.
translation: 你需要預備一位具有估價技能的經紀人。
